provenance.original_six: All search, repair, review, evaluation and wall-clock caps are unchanged; completed seed-17 runs may be reused only with matching source, data and configuration hashes.
provenance.additional_instances: pu-cs-fal07 (174 classes, 13 rooms, 2002 students), lums-spr18 (487 classes, 73 rooms, no students), tg-spr18 (676 classes, 24 rooms, no students). Different institutions and sizes; not a representative sample of all 36 instances.
provenance.new_budget_rule: Provisional engineering caps fixed before examining controller outcomes: the existing default population 20 / partitions 3, 200 generations, 1200 logical evaluations, 1200 seconds per method. Not tuned or claimed optimal.
provenance.comparison_rule: Descriptive paired endpoints at shared caps. Rank soft scores only when both endpoints are feasible. Mark evaluation-censored runs separately; never treat API failures as losses.
provenance.multi_budget_rule: Same maximum 12 reviews and operator evaluation cap; up to 24 requests for Inspector then Planner, versus up to 12 single-agent requests. Record both calls and pacing latency.
provenance.retry_rule: Preserve every attempt. At most one whole-run retry for a transient service/network/timeout failure; never retry quota/auth/billing failures automatically, and never select a completed attempt by score.
